text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 10, 2024) for 1650 Keele Street.

The Property Standards Committee - Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 10, 2024) for 1650 Keele Street, Folder Number 24 207771 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to October 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
